messages.subject: Scaling factor of 1.7
parts:
Dear mirt members,

I'm seeking clarification on the parameterization methodology employed by the mirt package. Considering that other software packages, like PARSCALE, offer both logistic and ogive metrics, I'm curious if mirt follows a standard procedure or allows users to select their preferred metric.

Thanks a lot in advance. Best regards
